commands.text: Jori lifts the bar with her shoulder. The charcoal yard opens onto a road of overturned handcarts.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: This gate faces the village. Whatever we leave behind it will reach the houses first.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The carts stopped before the captain came. We had nowhere left to put the charcoal.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: And no one left who could tell me which workers were missing.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then we start with the road. No bell, no shouting. Let the dead follow our feet.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: I will mark what we know. You bring back what can still be read.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: Stay on the pale chalk. The dark lines are cracks, not paths.
